concepts.subject: Diverse team meeting room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a well-lit, modern conference room with a diverse group of 5 professionals seated around a wooden table, warm color palette, relaxed mood, slightly above eye-level camera angle, natural lighting, and a cityscape background through a glass wall.
concepts.title: Diverse Team Meeting In Conference Room
concepts.description: A group of diverse business professionals are seated around a conference table in a modern office, engaged in a meeting. The room has a city view and natural light pours in through the glass wall. The team members are of different ages, genders, and ethnicities.

concepts.subject: Happy family outdoor picnic
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a vibrant, sunny outdoor scene of a happy family of four having a picnic in a park, with a colorful blanket, a wicker basket, and a variety of food, warm and inviting lighting, slight camera tilt, and lush green trees in the background.
concepts.title: Family Enjoying Outdoor Picnic In Park
concepts.description: A happy family of four, with two children, is enjoying a picnic in a park. They are seated on a colorful blanket, surrounded by a wicker basket and various food items. The scene is set in a lush green park with trees in the background.

concepts.subject: Freshly brewed coffee cup
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a high-contrast, close-up image of a freshly brewed cup of coffee, on a minimalist wooden table, with a shallow depth of field, natural light pouring in from the side, and a clean, simple composition.
concepts.title: Freshly Brewed Cup Of Coffee
concepts.description: A close-up image of a freshly brewed cup of coffee, placed on a simple wooden table. The coffee is in a white cup, and the scene is illuminated by natural light pouring in from the side.

concepts.subject: Young programmer coding laptop
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a modern, dimly lit scene of a young programmer, seated in a sleek, minimalist room, focused on coding on a laptop, with a cityscape background visible through a large glass window, and a shallow depth of field, emphasizing the programmer's face and hands.
concepts.title: Young Programmer Coding On Laptop
concepts.description: A young programmer is seated in a modern, minimalist room, focused on coding on a laptop. The room has a large glass window with a cityscape view, and the scene is dimly lit, with a shallow depth of field.

concepts.subject: Serene mountain lake landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a breathtaking, panoramic image of a serene mountain lake, surrounded by lush green trees and towering mountains, with a few fluffy white clouds in the sky, and a warm, golden light, reflecting off the calm water.
concepts.title: Serene Mountain Lake Landscape
concepts.description: A panoramic image of a serene mountain lake, surrounded by lush green trees and towering mountains. The sky has a few fluffy white clouds, and the scene is illuminated by warm, golden light, reflecting off the calm water.

concepts.subject: Diverse group friends laughing
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a vibrant, energetic image of a diverse group of friends, from different ages, genders, and ethnicities, laughing and having fun together, in a colorful, urban environment, with a shallow depth of field, and a warm, sunny lighting.

concepts.description: A diverse group of friends, from different ages, genders, and ethnicities, are laughing and having fun together, in a colorful, urban environment. The scene is vibrant and energetic, with a shallow depth of field, and warm, sunny lighting.

concepts.description: A person is meditating outdoors, surrounded by nature, with a calm lake or ocean in the background. The scene is peaceful and serene, with warm, soft lighting, and a shallow depth of field, emphasizing the person's peaceful expression.
